name: AI Healthcare Growth Agent - Daily Content

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{product:'AI Healthcare Growth Kit', platform:'Instagram', topic:'Use the next READY item from your content calendar', specialty:'Healthcare marketing', audience:'Doctors, clinics and healthcare marketers', language:'English', tone:'professional, practical, trustworthy', offer:'Complete Bundle ₹1,999', approvalRequired:true}}];

values.content: You are the AI Healthcare Growth Kit content agent. Return only valid JSON with hook, caption, script, cta, hashtags, thumbnail_text, visual_brief, disclaimer, claims_to_verify. Never diagnose viewers, promise medical outcomes, invent medical statistics/citations, or expose patient information. Flag clinical claims for human review.
Generate one social post using this brief: {{$json}}

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; const text=JSON.stringify(x); const blocked=[/guarantee/i,/100% cure/i,/diagnose you/i,/patient name/i]; const hit=blocked.filter(r=>r.test(text)); return [{json:{...x,qa_status:hit.length?'BLOCK':'REVIEW',qa_issues:hit.map(r=>r.toString()),approvalRequired:true}}];
return [{json:{status:'READY_FOR_PUBLISHING', content:$json, note:'Connect this output to your approved social publishing provider/API.'}}];
